versions.changelog: v3.0.0: the toolkit can now fetch miRNA sequences from public databases itself - new scripts/fetch_mirnas.py (local mature.fa > cache > miRBase multi-URL download > RNAcentral fallback, all cached) plus --mirna-species to pull EVERY mature miRNA of a species and comma-separated --mirna names, integrated into the whole-transcriptome predictor. Bug fixes: rnahybrid-only mode no longer drops all hits when --min-score is set. Docs: new Runtime-and-hardware sections (speed depends on CPU cores/clock, RAM and engine choice, with measured reference numbers) in SKILL.md/README/workflow.md.

v2.2.0: two documented whole-transcriptome strategies - (A) three-stage cascade: seed scan + miRanda hybrid confirmation + RNAhybrid exact-MFE refinement of the top N per miRNA (--refine-rnahybrid N; fast), and (B) triple parallel: seed + miRanda + RNAhybrid over everything with a three-way intersection (--method triple; slow, most complete, evidence column per row). Adds --method rnahybrid, --rnahybrid-energy, --rnahybrid-dataset, --rnahybrid-max-target (RNAhybrid silently skips long targets - fixed), targets.tsv columns rnahybrid_hits/best_rnahybrid_mfe/pvalue/evidence/mfe_verified, and docs for both strategies.

v2.1.0: predict_targets_genome.py gains real prediction engines - --method miranda (full duplex alignment, score + dG) and --method hybrid (seed sites confirmed by an overlapping miRanda alignment; now the default when miRanda is installed), plus --target-region utr which slices 3'UTRs from the Ensembl GTF (auto-downloaded, complete annotation preferred) for biologically faithful scanning. Adds --miranda-score/--miranda-energy/--min-utr-length/--jobs, coverage reporting in run_info, and docs for engines/region.

v2.0.4: rewrite the skill description and Overview to cover the current feature set (whole-transcriptome prediction with built-in species, BH-FDR enrichment, R/ggplot2 publication figures, conservation, Cytoscape export); README intro aligned.

v2.0.2: apply the same publication aesthetic to conservation figures (sequence logo + alignment): white background, no top/right spines, muted ticks, left-aligned titles, soft seed-region wash, white-edged bars, adaptive position ticks, editable-text SVG. Docs: generic example names, SVG/dot-plot wording.

v2.0.1: rebuild plot_enrichment.py as a publication-style dot plot (clusterProfiler-like: size = genes in term, colour = -log10 p on a blue-to-red ramp, size legend, slim colour bar, wrapped labels, left-aligned title); adds --svg/--dpi/--wrap/--sort/--title; docs updated.

v2.0.0: add predict_targets_genome.py - whole-transcriptome seed-based target prediction from user-supplied miRNA sequences; built-in Ensembl presets (human/mouse/rat/sheep/goat/cow/pig/chicken) with on-demand caching, plus custom --mrna-fa and --genome-fa+--gtf import; SKILL.md/workflow.md/README updated.
English rewrite (SKILL.md, workflow.md, script comments/help). Fix unquoted YAML description so the registry summary parses.
Translate SKILL.md, references/workflow.md, and script comments/help text to English; English description.
Expand conservation-analysis docs in README: dual input modes, options table, output files, free-end-gap alignment note
